name: Chrysanthemum
summary: The chrysanthemum, called 'ju hua' in Chinese, was, and still is, a common garden flower in south China. Unfamiliar flora and fauna were of great interest to British botanists in the 18th and 19th centuries, and such enthusiasm gradually filtered down to the general public. Travellers often returned
